meta.title: x/tools/gopls: bad formatting with CRLF line ending
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@cf7880770c1e (internal/lsp: reproduce and fix golang/go#41057; CL 252457)
meta.build_notes: Both built with the local Go (go1.27.1) through a wrapper module (their go.mod replaces x/tools); the server runs the local go command. v0.4.4 was tagged 2020-07-29, the fix merged 2020-09-02, v0.5.0 was tagged 2020-09-14. (Analyses of these builds panic under go1.27, see gopls-41311; import organization does not use them.)
meta.notes: Import organization (run on save by the editor, source.organizeImports) computes its edit from the import prefix of the file, which ended at a multi-line comment's End position; with CRLF line endings that position is two bytes short of the closing '*/' (golang/go#41197), so the edit re-inserted '*/'. The fix accounts for the '*/'.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; organize imports on save is the editor default of the Go extension.

files.note: verbatim with CRLF line endings, as the title says (the code block itself is shown with LF)
a module around the file; go 1.14, the Go of the era

repro.steps: Open main.go (CRLF line endings, a /* */ doc comment above func Gronk). Run organize imports (source.organizeImports at 0:0), which the editor runs on save. Reported: after saving, the comment's closing '*/' appears twice, which does not parse. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have (an empty edit adds none).
